SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    e.id::text AS event_id,
    e.created_at::text AS created_at,
    e.wa_message_id,
    e.phone,
    e.conversation_id::text AS conversation_id,
    e.button_key,
    e.status,
    COALESCE(e.reason, '') AS reason,
    COALESCE(e.processing_status, '') AS processing_status,
    e.processed_at::text AS processed_at,
    e.interaction_id,
    e.interaction_type,
    e.action_id,
    e.processed_state,
    c.chatwoot_conv_id,
    c.estado::text AS conversation_state,
    c.active_interaction_id,
    c.active_interaction_type,
    c.interaction_consumed,
    c.automation_enabled,
    c.human_handoff
  FROM whatsapp_interaction_events e
  LEFT JOIN conversaciones c ON c.id = e.conversation_id
  WHERE e.created_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
    AND e.status IN ('DUPLICATE', 'STALE', 'FAILED')
    AND COALESCE(e.processing_status, '') NOT IN ('RESCUED', 'RESCUE_PROCESSING', 'RESCUE_SKIPPED_PUBLIC_REPLY', 'RESCUE_SKIPPED_EXISTING_PROPOSAL', 'RESCUE_SKIPPED_CHATWOOT_UNVERIFIED')
    AND COALESCE(e.reason, '') NOT IN ('duplicate_message_id', 'duplicate_race')
    AND NOT (
      (
        e.status = 'STALE'
          AND COALESCE(e.reason, '') = 'stale_interaction_type'
          AND e.interaction_type = 'TOPIC_SELECTION'
          AND e.button_key ~ '^gancho_q2_(seguridad|control|planes)(?:_gancho_v[0-9]+)?$'
          AND (
            c.active_interaction_type = 'PLAN_SELECTION'
            OR c.estado::text IN ('QUOTED', 'PLAN_SELECTED', 'PROPOSAL_SENT')
            OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM conversation_interactions ci
              WHERE ci.conversation_id = c.id
                AND ci.interaction_type = 'PLAN_SELECTION'
                AND ci.status = 'ACTIVE'
                AND COALESCE(ci.consumed, false) = false
            )
          )
      )
      OR (
        e.status = 'STALE'
          AND COALESCE(e.reason, '') = 'stale_interaction_type'
          AND e.interaction_type = 'INTRO_CTA'
          AND e.action_id = 'INTRO_ACCEPT'
          AND (
            c.active_interaction_type IN ('TOPIC_SELECTION', 'PLAN_SELECTION')
            OR c.estado::text IN ('ENGAGED', 'VALUE_PRESENTED', 'QUOTED', 'PLAN_SELECTED', 'PROPOSAL_SENT')
          )
          AND (
            COALESCE(c.gancho_step, '') IN ('Q2_SENT', 'TOPIC_SELECTED', 'Q2_ANSWERED', 'COMPLETED')
            OR COALESCE(c.gancho_result, '') IN ('ACCEPTED', 'FREE_TEXT')
            OR COALESCE(c.gancho_answers, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'Q1_ACCEPTED'
            OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM whatsapp_interaction_events p
              WHERE p.conversation_id = e.conversation_id
                AND p.interaction_type = 'INTRO_CTA'
                AND p.status = 'PROCESSED'
                AND p.created_at < e.created_at
            )
          )
      )
      OR (
        e.status = 'DUPLICATE'
          AND COALESCE(e.reason, '') IN ('interaction_already_consumed', 'button_already_consumed')
          AND e.interaction_type = 'INTRO_CTA'
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM whatsapp_interaction_events p
            WHERE p.conversation_id = e.conversation_id
              AND p.interaction_type = 'INTRO_CTA'
              AND p.status = 'PROCESSED'
              AND p.button_key = e.button_key
              AND p.created_at >= e.created_at - interval '3 minutes'
              AND p.created_at < e.created_at
          )
      )
    )
    AND (
      e.interaction_type IN ('PLAN_SELECTION', 'PROPOSAL_CONFIRMATION', 'TOPIC_SELECTION')
      OR e.button_key ~ '^plan_[a-z0-9_]+_(12|24|36)m$'
      OR e.button_key ~ '^gancho_q2_(seguridad|control|planes)(?:_gancho_v[0-9]+)?$'
      OR e.button_key ~ '^gancho_(si|no)_(?:gancho_v[0-9]+|gancho_q1_neutral)$'
      OR e.button_key IN (
        'enviar_propuesta', 'send_proposal',
        'si_quiero_contratar', 'quiero_contratar', 'contract_now',
        'contactar_a_un_asesor', 'hablar_con_asesor',
        'revisar_otro_plan', 'tengo_una_duda',
        'si_quiero_saber_mas', 'si_enviarme_informacion', 'si_enviar_informacion',
        'si_quiero_conocerlas', 'si_quiero_conocer', 'si_enviarlo',
        'si_muestrame_las_opciones', 'si_muestreme_las_opciones',
        'si_compartir_guia', 'si_cuentame_mas', 'cuentame_mas',
        'quiero_descubrirlas', 'deseo_mas_info', 'deseo_mas_informacion',
        'no_por_el_momento', 'no_es_de_mi_interes', 'no_gracias', 'no_por_ahora'
      )
    )
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT now()::text AS checked_at,
       COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(candidates) ORDER BY created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
FROM candidates;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH target AS (
  SELECT
    e.id AS event_uuid,
    e.id::text AS event_id,
    e.created_at::text AS created_at,
    e.wa_message_id,
    e.phone,
    e.conversation_id,
    e.button_key,
    e.status,
    COALESCE(e.reason, '') AS reason,
    e.interaction_id,
    e.interaction_type,
    e.action_id,
    c.chatwoot_conv_id,
    c.estado::text AS conversation_state,
    c.active_interaction_id,
    c.active_interaction_type,
    c.interaction_consumed,
    c.automation_enabled,
    c.human_handoff,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM conversation_interactions ci
      WHERE ci.conversation_id = c.id
        AND ci.interaction_type = 'PROPOSAL_CONFIRMATION'
        AND ci.status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND COALESCE(ci.consumed, false) = false
    ) AS has_active_proposal_confirmation,
    lm.selected_plan,
    lm.selected_plan_name,
    lm.selected_plan_price::text AS selected_plan_price,
    lm.selected_plan_duration::text AS selected_plan_duration
  FROM whatsapp_interaction_events e
  JOIN conversaciones c ON c.id = e.conversation_id
  LEFT JOIN lead_memory lm ON lm.conversation_id = c.id
  WHERE e.id = $1::uuid
  FOR UPDATE OF e, c
), eligible AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM target
  WHERE status = 'STALE'
    AND reason = 'stale_state'
    AND button_key ~ '^plan_[a-z0-9_]+_(12|24|36)m$'
    AND conversation_state = 'PLAN_SELECTED'
    AND active_interaction_type = 'PLAN_SELECTION'
    AND active_interaction_id IS NOT NULL
    AND active_interaction_id = interaction_id
    AND COALESCE(interaction_consumed, false) = false
    AND COALESCE(automation_enabled, true) = true
    AND COALESCE(human_handoff, false) = false
    AND conversation_state NOT IN ('HANDOFF_HUMAN', 'WON', 'LOST', 'NOT_CONTACTABLE', 'CONTACTAR', 'DISCARDED')
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE whatsapp_interaction_events e
  SET processing_status = 'RESCUE_PROCESSING',
      processed_at = $2::timestamptz
  FROM eligible
  WHERE e.id = eligible.event_uuid
    AND COALESCE(e.processing_status, '') NOT LIKE 'RESCUE_%'
    AND COALESCE(e.processing_status, '') <> 'RESCUED'
  RETURNING e.id
)
SELECT eligible.*, true AS rescue_claimed
FROM eligible
JOIN claimed ON claimed.id = eligible.event_uuid;

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS event_id,
    $2::uuid AS conversation_id,
    $3::boolean AS meta_sent,
    NULLIF($4::text, '') AS meta_message_id,
    NULLIF($5::text, '') AS rescue_status,
    NULLIF($6::text, '') AS rescue_failure,
    NULLIF($7::text, '') AS selected_plan_name,
    NULLIF($8::text, '') AS selected_plan_duration,
    NULLIF($9::text, '') AS selected_plan_price,
    COALESCE($10::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS details
), target AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.conversation_id
  FROM whatsapp_interaction_events e
  JOIN input i ON i.event_id = e.id
  WHERE e.processing_status = 'RESCUE_PROCESSING'
), activated AS (
  SELECT a.interaction_id_out AS interaction_id, a.conversation_version_out AS conversation_version
  FROM input i
  JOIN target t ON t.conversation_id = i.conversation_id
    AND i.meta_sent = true
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL set_active_conversation_interaction(
    i.conversation_id,
    'PROPOSAL_CONFIRMATION',
    ARRAY['CONTRACT_NOW', 'SEND_PROPOSAL', 'TALK_TO_ADVISOR', 'REVIEW_OTHER_PLAN']::text[],
    'PLAN_SELECTED',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'OPS-11 Silent Button Sentinel auto-rescue',
      'rescued_event_id', i.event_id::text,
      'meta_message_id', i.meta_message_id,
      'selected_plan_name', i.selected_plan_name,
      'selected_plan_duration', i.selected_plan_duration,
      'selected_plan_price', i.selected_plan_price
    ) || i.details
  ) a
), updated AS (
  UPDATE whatsapp_interaction_events e
  SET processing_status = CASE
        WHEN i.meta_sent = true AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activated) THEN 'RESCUED'
        WHEN i.meta_sent = true THEN 'RESCUE_FAILED_ACTIVATION'
        WHEN COALESCE(i.rescue_status, '') LIKE 'RESCUE_%' THEN i.rescue_status
        ELSE 'RESCUE_FAILED'
      END,
      processed_at = now()
  FROM input i, target t
  WHERE e.id = i.event_id
    AND t.id = e.id
  RETURNING e.id::text AS event_id, e.processing_status, e.conversation_id
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO eventos_conversacion (conversation_id, tipo_evento, actor, datos_evento)
  SELECT
    i.conversation_id,
    CASE WHEN u.processing_status = 'RESCUED' THEN 'OPS11_PLAN_RESCUE_SENT' ELSE 'OPS11_PLAN_RESCUE_SKIPPED' END,
    'OPS-11',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'event_id', i.event_id::text,
      'processing_status', u.processing_status,
      'rescue_failure', i.rescue_failure,
      'meta_message_id', i.meta_message_id,
      'meta_sent', i.meta_sent,
      'proposal_interaction_id', (SELECT interaction_id FROM activated LIMIT 1)
    ) || i.details
  FROM input i
  JOIN updated u ON true
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT processing_status FROM updated LIMIT 1), 'not_marked') AS rescue_mark_status,
  (SELECT interaction_id FROM activated LIMIT 1) AS proposal_interaction_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM logged) AS log_count;
